book.name: Maluku
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Maluku

content: Yecho ajhakulonge kubomola kwa nyumba jha Chapanga.
Yecho pakibha apitita mu Nyumba jha Chapanga, jhumo jwa bhabholwa bhake ajhakunnobholela, “Mmola, dolekeya maghanga na majhumba ghanga chighabhii ghambone gha kukangacha!”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Bho, mughahwene majhumba ghanga chighabhii makolongwa? Libhii jhe hilu lighanga limo lilipala kuhighalika panane jha lighanga lenge, kila kilebhe nakibhaha heghuheghu.”
Malagho na lung'ahe
Yecho pakibha atamite panane pa kitombe chuku Micheitune alolekiya Nyumba jha Chapanga, Petile na Yakobu na Yohane na Anduleya bhajhakunkonya pakiyepela,
“Chonde, mutulobholele ilebhe henge naihengeka ligha? Bho, na nginyililo ghane jhipala kulangiya kuhika kwino na upehekelo gwa machiko?”
Yecho ajhakutumbuu kwalobholela, “Mukilolekehe mundo akoto kuhika na kunkopokeya.
Bhamahena nabhahika kwa liina lyango, jhumo nalongela, jwenio ndi nenga! Na bhene nabhankopokeya bhando bhamahele.
Pumipala kujhoha mbwepo ya ngondo na bhando bhalonge malobhe gha ngondo, nkotoka kujhoghopa. Ilebhe yenio naipitila tugha, Nambo kujhomokela kwake kwamela.

Kilambo chimo na akakomana na kilambo chenge, unahota nkolongwa ghumo naukomana na unahota ghonge, kila chehemo napabha nnindimilo gwa nnema nailongohana na njala. Ilebhe henge ngita lipyanda lya kutumbuu kupapa.”

“Mangota mwe mukilangiye mana bhando nabhatenda kuntakalila pa bwalo, na kunchwapula yato mu Nyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude. Nabhampeleka palonge jha akanahota malongelele, ndi kwa nhwalo gwa nenga.
Nambo Malobhe gha Mbone naghatangachwa kwa ilambo yoha.

Na bhene pibhapala kunkamu na kuntakalila, nkoto kubhehe na kindondwa chimpala kulonge. Muda pupala kuhika nnongele chochoha chimpala kupelwa, mangota mwe ndeka jhumpala kulonge, nambo Uhuke gwa Chapanga.
Nnongo nanyambila nnongo mundo akomwe na tate nanyambila mwana mundo, na yana yenio hele nabhakachulana akatate bhabhe na kwakoma.
Bhando bhoha nabhanchimwa mangota nhwalo gwa liina lyango, nambo jwapala kuhimbilila ade kujhomolela jwenio naghombokoka mulung'ahe lwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.”
Ling'ahe likolo
“Pumpala kubhona lijhambu lihakanaho lilihangabhana lijhemite pangapala kujhema.” Jwachoma na amanye. Peniya bhubhabhii pa Yudeya bhabhutikila ku kitombe.
Nambo mundo jhojhoha jwabhii pa kipaghalo akotoka kuhuluka kujhingii nkate na kutola ilebhe yake!
Helahela jwabhii kunghonda akotoka kubhujha kajhake na kutola magwanda ghake.
Nakole kiya hake kwa akakeghe bhubhabhii na ndumbo na bhibhajhongecha nabhabhaha mumalagho kwa machiko gheniya!
Mbaha tunyope ilebhe yenio ikoto kupitii machiko gha malile.
Nhwalo machiko gheniya napabhaha na lung'ahe kuhumii Chapanga mukupanganwa nnema lunawahijhe kupitila na hilu naipitijhe kabhele.
Peniya Bhambo nakupongocha jhe machiko gheniya abhii jhe mundo jwapala kughombokoka. Peniya nhwalo gwa bhando bhake, apongwiche machiko gheniya.
“Bhahe, mundo anda anongalile, ‘Dolekeya, Kilichitu abhii pamba,’ amu ‘Abhii kola,’ nkotoka kunyokanikiya.
Nhwalo nabhapitila bhakilichitu bhuwange na milondole bhauwange. Nabhalangiya nginyililo ngolonga na ikangacho ya kuhotu kwakopokeya bhando bhake Chapanga anda nabhahotola.
Mangota mwe mukilolekeye. Nenga ninnobholile ghoha kabula jha kupitila.
Kuhika kwake kwa mwana gwa mundo
“Machiko gheniya, pulupala kupeta lung'ahe lono, lyobha nalibhaha nkate mulubhendo na mwehe naupihajhe lilangamule.
Na ndondwa naigwaha kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga, na ilebhe yoha na likakala lya kunane kwa Chapanga nainyukanyuka.
Peniya naumona nenga, Mwana gwa Mundo, nikahika na mahunde na kwa makakala twe gha ukolo.
Peniya nabhatuma akatumiche bhake bhajhende mu pande yoha ncheche ya nnema bhakabhatole bhando bhake bhubhahaghulilwe na Chapanga kuhumii mujhomokelo ghongo ade upeekeho gwa nnema.”
Libholo lya nkongo nkojho
“Mukibhole nnandanikiho ghongo kuhumii nkongo gwa nkojho, mandabhe gha nkongo ghabhii mabhehe utumbuu kupiya mahamba, umanye kubhehe machiko gha kuhuna ghabhandikile.
Helahela kwa mangota pimpala kughabhona ghahengeka gheniya ghoha, umanya Mwana gwa Mundo abhandikii kuhika.
Ninnobholela chakaka, kibheluko chenje nakipete jhe kabula jha kuhengeka ghanga.
Kunane kwa Chapanga na ilambo yoha nahipeta, nambo Malobhe ghango naghapitila ngita chinilonge.
Abhii jhe jwamanya lichiko lyenio
“Nambo abhii jhe mundo jwamanya lichiko amu lichaa lyenio nalihika ligha, hilu akatumiche bha kunane kwa Chapanga. Hilu Mwana, nga Tate ndi jwamanya.
Mukilolekehe na kukilenganikiya nhwalo mulimanyitejhe lichiko hilu lichaa lya kuhika.
Naibhaha anda mundo jwabhokite pakajha jhake kutumbu mwanja na kwalekela ukindendeke akatumiche bhubhahighalike kajha, kila jhumo na lihengo lyake na kunobholela nnonda jwa pakajha akotoka kugholoka.
Chonde nkeluwe bhahe, mukilenganikiye, nhwalo umanyitejhe nkolo nyumba nabhujha ligha. Pange kimihe amu uhiko amu putiputi amu lukela.
Chonde mukilolekeye na mukakilenganikiye, anda ahikite kwa kupwitikalila, kongo ankoli ngholwike.
Malobhe ghuninnobholela mangota, chonde ninnobholela mabhoha. Mukilolekehe na mukilenganikiye!”
